claim: The earliest dated source for an investment cost number is jAthena //0795 and 817, which implement a flat 10,000z fee
No period source dated 2004-06 or earlier documents the bracketed investment cost table (5k to 955k); earliest sources are post-2006 Japanese wikis and GungHo guides

source.searched: Wayback captures of iRO (warofemperium.asp 2004-04-05), kRO patch notices (Apr 2003-Jun 2004), jAthena history (//0795-//1035), and RODataZone

reasoning: The bracketed formula and table (5k/20k at 1-4 scaling to 955k/3,820k at 95-99) only appears in later documentation (w.atwiki.jp/ragnarokgvg and modern ragnarokonline.gungho.jp/guide/gvg/); period official sources give no cost table and period emulators use a flat 10,000z.
